category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: Free account: a 45-60 sec wait timer before a download, a maximum transfer size of 2 GB, 20 transfers per day and 5 recipients per transfer; guest downloads have a device daily cap of 10/day. Premium removes the countdown: 30 days USD 19, 90 days USD 39, 180 days USD 59, 365 days USD 99.

per_object_cap.stated: Maximum transfer size (combined size of all files in one transfer): 5 GB Premium, 2 GB Free, 1 GB Guest.

retention.stated: Transfer expiry range 1-90 days Premium, 1-30 days Free, 1-7 days Guest; transfer history kept 1 year Premium and 30 days Free; account file cleanup depends on account status and activity.

egress.terms: The vendor pricing page lists 'No public countdown', 'Direct downloads' and 'Larger transfer allowances' for Premium, a 45-60 sec wait timer for Free and Guest downloads, and a device daily cap of 10/day for Guest downloads; it publishes no byte allowance and no TrafficShare figure.
egress.free_allowance: not published: the pricing page shows the Premium and Free account allowances without a number and Guest downloads at 10/day

interface_detail: No API documentation reachable; the site presents FileFactory Transfer (send files by email or link) and serves its Premium pricing at /premium.
tooling: browser; download managers supported per the premium feature list
chaining: Only useful if a user's links are FileFactory links; its 2025-era share of link-site posts is small next to Rapidgator and 1fichier.

limits.value: 45-60 sec wait timer before Free and Guest downloads; Guest downloads capped at 10/day per device
daily transfer limit 100 Premium, 20 Free, 3 Guest; maximum transfer size 5 GB Premium, 2 GB Free, 1 GB Guest; Premium download allowance stated as 'Larger transfer allowances' with no number

limits_note: The vendor pricing page no longer claims unlimited bandwidth: Premium is 'Larger transfer allowances' with no number, and the account download allowances are shown without a figure.
binding_note: The vendor publishes a 45-60 sec wait timer for free downloads and no byte allowance for Premium downloads ('Larger transfer allowances'), so an unpublished allowance is what can fail at 1 TiB/month.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up offers 'Sign up with Google' or 'Sign up with email'; the About page says 'No credit card required'; payments are settled via Odeonpay ALE S.R.L. (Paysagi) as Merchant of Record.

reliability_note: Account file cleanup depends on account status and activity (vendor pricing page). An unauthenticated read of /premium from a datacenter address was answered with an 'Access Restricted' page, while two other provider routes were served the pricing page.
confidence_note: The vendor pricing page read on 2026-11-03 states the four Premium prices, the wait timer, the transfer limits and the transfer expiry ranges. The per-file download cap and the Premium byte allowance are not published there.
